caption: The drawing depicts two objects on a plain, light beige background. The main object is a dark metallic teapot with a distinct, slightly angular body, a curved spout, and a hinged, partially open lid that is round and appears to have an engraved or embossed design. The teapot's handle is thin and arched, attached on either side of the lid, and the surface of the teapot shows a textured appearance with various shades of brown and dark gray, with hints of rust on the inside of the open lid. Below and to the left of the teapot, there is an oval-shaped metal medallion or tag with an intricate raised design featuring a crown and text encircling it, and a small hole at the top of the medallion for attachment. The composition places the teapot in the upper right portion and the medallion in the lower left of the image, with the two objects separated by empty space. The words "ROCCO DANTE NAVIGATO" appear on the right side in small, uppercase letters.
title: Iron Kettle
